description: Record the editorial queue's AI editor decision (approved or rejected) on a story revision or an AI brief, as the first-party service principal acting as itself (a svc: principal with no X-OV-Subject). This is never a person's review: an approval lets AI text publish and index and the page says "Checked by OpenVibe's AI editor" with its date, never "Reviewed by a person". Granted only to the orchestrator's service principal.
